weekend_race.race_comments: Ryan Blaney has won the Coke Zero Sugar 400 at Daytona International Speedway, his 15th victory in the NASCAR Cup Series. Prior to the start of the race, the following vehicle(s) dropped to the rear of the field under penalty: No. 44 (unapproved adjustments), and No. 24 (Unapproved adjustments after inspections, crew chief was ejected car will start at the rear of the field and must perform a stop and go penalty after they receive the green flag.)
